page.overview:
Who is Moose Devil?

The Moose Devil looks like a heavily grotesque moose it has human like hands instead of hooves, it has small glowing red eyes, a smile filled with human teeth, massive antlers, with its body being mostly black but there are some white patches around its body, and what seems to be like smaller antlers coming from its back.

The Moose Devil's personality is currently unknown besides the fact that is presumably possesses hatred for humans like all non-humanoid devils.

At some point the Moose Devil started inhabiting a bamboo forest it was consuming a corpse from inside a bamboo forest when two Civilian Devil Hunters approach it with one of them calling the devil in the as the Moose Devil simply just looks at the two hunters.

As a Devil, the Moose Devil possesses all of the standard devil abilities.
